description: asdf is a Pure Data library providing the asdf~ external, which loads dynamic 3D audio scenes described in the XML-based Audio Scene Description Format and supplies their source signals and control messages. Its implementation is part of the official Rust ASDF reference implementation.

research.notes: The official Pd announcement identifies asdf~ as the Deken external and directs bug reports and suggestions to the asdf-rust issue tracker; the repository contains a pure-data directory and releases corresponding to the Deken package versions.
